title: Design Uber
description: Design a ride-hailing service that finds eligible nearby drivers, safely assigns one driver to a trip and tracks the trip lifecycle.
functionalRequirements: Request, accept or cancel a ride
Receive driver location updates and estimate pickup time
Assign a driver without simultaneous conflicting assignments
Track trip transitions and request idempotent payment after completion
nonFunctionalRequirements: Matching server p95 below 1 second at the stated regional peak
No two nonterminal trips may own the same driver; temporary offers have separate lease semantics
constraints: 10 million DAU and 20 million ride requests/day with a 5x request peak
Size for 500000 simultaneously updating drivers at one location update every 5 seconds
Treat latest locations as expiring state; historical GPS traces are an optional separate storage workload
outOfScope: Exact proprietary dispatch or pricing models
Autonomous driving and detailed card-processing implementation

scale.assumption: Synthetic interview workload, not a claim about any named company's actual traffic.

rates.name: Location updates at sustained sizing concurrency

stateEstimates.name: Latest positions for 500000 concurrently active drivers

notes: The location daily volume is a capacity envelope assuming the stated concurrency all day, not an assertion about actual driver activity.
A latest-position state estimate excludes geospatial-index, allocator and replication overhead beyond the explicit factor.
Historical GPS traces, ETA model data and card-provider storage are not in the trip byte estimate.
